input.quote: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf a worldwide, non-exclusive right during the subscription term to access and use the hosted Services and documentation for their internal business purposes
input.rationale: Preferred position met: the grant expressly covers Affiliates and contractors, paid-up/embedded material is perpetual, irrevocable and royalty-free with modification rights (§13.2), rights are transferable to an Affiliate or successor (§13.3), and revocation/suspension is limited to material uncured breach after notice and cure.
